title: Build troubles.  (xDrip should have a reliable documented automated build procedure)
body:
I'm trying to build xDrip.  I have never before built any Android program or any java program.  Here are the troubles I'm running into.

----

EDIT: Nevermind actually.  At last, I successfully built it.  Here is the working build procedure:

```
wget -c https://dl.google.com/android/repository/sdk-tools-linux-4333796.zip -O ../sdk-tools-linux-4333796.zip.partial
mv ../sdk-tools-linux-4333796.zip.partial ../sdk-tools-linux-4333796.zip
unzip -d ${ANDROID_HOME} ../sdk-tools-linux-4333796.zip
mkdir ${ANDROID_HOME}
yes | ${ANDROID_HOME}/tools/bin/sdkmanager --licenses
yes | ${ANDROID_HOME}/tools/bin/sdkmanager "platforms;android-26" "build-tools;27.0.3" "extras;google;m2repository"
bash gradlew assembleRelease
ln -sf app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk .
```


-----

I have a `Makefile` that generated these commands.  It should make it possible simply to run `git clone`, `cd xDrip` and then download and build the `.apk` just by typing `make`.  I will try it out on a fresh directory later to make sure.  Then I'll put it in a PR.
